jobs.title: Anthropic: Community Engagement Manager, Data Centers (Texas)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Austin, TX | Remote-Friendly, United States

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Texas to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

You will travel regularly within your region, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with local elected officials, government agencies, economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the data center markets you cover

  • Develop and execute a community engagement strategy for each of your markets, spanning site selection, pre-development, construction, and ongoing operations

  • Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate

  • Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media

  • Prospecting & Outreach
    • Research pharmaceutical companies, brands, therapeutic areas, agencies, and potential partners.

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $67,000 - $95,0000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications. 

Why Talkspace? 

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse  “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace? 

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Clover Health: Chairman Programs Lead
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Own the white space. Operate with autonomy. Drive the programs that move the company.

We’re hiring a high-agency operator into the Office of the Chairman to drive Clover’s most important cross-functional initiatives from ambiguity to execution and results.

This is a rare role designed for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, systems design, and executional rigor. You’ll operate as a force-multiplier to the Chairman and executive team: orchestrating execution across organizational boundaries, defining innovative pilots, testing hypotheses, structuring problems that don’t yet have owners, and driving initiatives that directly shape Clover’s growth and operational leverage.

As a Chairman Programs Lead, you will:

  • Architect Strategic Programs: Translate high-level goals into MECE workstreams with clear interfaces, owners, and timelines.
  • Drive Execution with Chairman-Standard Rigor: Own initiatives from kickoff through outcomes. Set the pace. Maintain altitude and detail without losing either.
  • Align Stakeholders Across Levels and Functions: Influence without authority. Drive accountability through clarity, not escalation.
  • Translate Ambiguity Into Action: When no playbook exists, build one. When priorities are unclear, force rank them. When coordination breaks down, rebuild the system.
  • Collaborate Across Boundaries: Manage projects that touch internal teams and external partners — vendors, regulators, and strategic collaborators. Align internal readiness to external dependencies.

Success in this role looks like:

  • First 90 days: Quickly grasp Clover's business model, establish key relationships, identify 2-3 high-priority initiatives, and implement a structured framework for tracking strategic projects.
  • First 6 months: Successfully drive multiple cross-functional initiatives to completion, develop systems improving operational efficiency, and establish yourself as a trusted Chairman advisor on strategic priorities.
  • First year: Create scalable coordination mechanisms that improve execution across teams, resolve strategic misalignments, and deliver measurable business impact on growth and operational leverage.

You should get in touch if:

  • You’ve had 3–10 years of experience at a top-tier consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG), in BizOps at a tech company, or in a high-trust internal strategy/Chief of Staff-type role. 
  • You think in structured logic, write with precision, and speak in synthesized insights.
  • You’re not a deck-maker. You’re a system builder who wants to see the impact of your thinking play out in operations.
  • You’ve driven complex, multi-org initiatives to the finish line — not just advised on them.
  • You’re energized by ambiguity, allergic to bureaucracy, and motivated by direct proximity to decision-making and value creation.

Why Talkspace? 

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse  “for purpose” space. How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace? 

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

 

Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager – Foundation Pillar

Team: Product Marketing
Reports to: VP, Product Marketing

About the Role

6sense is the GTM Intelligence Platform, and Foundation is the layer the rest of it stands on — "platform, data, infrastructure: the backbone everything builds on." It owns account and people data, matching and identity, the APIs and MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and the workflows that move data through the system. When buyers ask whether 6sense is accurate, extensible, secure, and composable, the answer lives here.

We're looking for a Principal Technical Product Marketing Manager to own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for the Foundation pillar. This is the most technical seat on the PMM team. You'll translate deep capabilities — identity resolution, data coverage and accuracy, API extensibility, the MCP framework, security and compliance — into differentiated stories that win over the technical and economic buyers who scrutinize them: RevOps architects, IT and security teams, data leaders, and increasingly developers building agentic GTM stacks.

You'll also carry one of the most strategically important narratives in the company: that 6sense is a composable intelligence layer other systems and AI agents plug into — "AI to the data, not data to the AI" — rather than a closed destination. With the MCP framework moving to GA, this is a present-tense story, and you'll be the one who tells it credibly.

What You'll Own

  • Positioning and messaging for the Foundation pillar — platform, data, infrastructure, identity and matching, APIs and the MCP framework, security and connectors, signal publication, and workflows. You set the narrative and keep it coherent with the Intelligence and Activation pillars.
  • Technical proof. Turn capability into credibility: architecture explainers, technical briefs and whitepapers, benchmarks, and reference narratives that substantiate the "backbone everything builds on" claim — especially around data accuracy, coverage, and identity resolution.
  • The composable / MCP-agent story. Own the infrastructure-layer narrative — 6sense as the data and intelligence layer that agentic GTM stacks compose with. Lead GTM for the MCP framework and the developer / technical-buyer audience it opens up.
  • Differentiation for the data and identity layer. Make the case against point data providers and infrastructure alternatives — coverage, match rates, identity quality, enrichment, security posture — and arm the field to win on it.
  • Field and partner enablement for technical evaluations. Build the battlecards, objection handling, FAQs, and solution content that win RFPs, security reviews, and technical POCs. Partner with Sales Engineering to make the technical buyer's diligence a place 6sense wins.
  • Launches. Drive end-to-end GTM for Foundation releases: new data assets, API and MCP capabilities, security packages (SCIM, SSO role mapping, audit, custom roles), connectors, and workflow features.
  • Cross-functional partnership. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Foundation Product and Engineering leaders to shape roadmap-to-market, and with Customer Success to surface the post-sale and admin/security use cases that prove the platform's breadth.
  • Market and competitive intelligence for the data and platform layer, feeding insight back into roadmap and pricing/packaging conversations.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in product marketing, technical product management, or a closely related function, with substantial technical PMM experience for platform, data, infrastructure, API, or developer products.
  • A proven ability to translate technical concepts — APIs, data pipelines, identity resolution, integrations, security, and AI/agent architectures like MCP — into crisp positioning and business value, without losing the engineers in the room or the buyers outside it.
  • A track record owning messaging for technical products and enabling technical sales motions (Sales Engineering, RFPs, security reviews, POCs).
  • Hands-on, not hand-wavy. You'll personally call the APIs, stand up and configure the MCP server, connect it to an agent, and build the demo — and your messaging is sharper because you've done the thing, not just read the spec.
  • Strong writing — you can produce content that is technically rigorous and genuinely clear, from a one-line value prop to an architecture whitepaper.
  • Fluency with the B2B SaaS buyer, ideally in martech, RevTech, or data platforms, and comfort selling to technical and economic buyers (RevOps architects, IT, security, data teams, developers).
  • The judgment and presence to operate as a senior individual contributor: set strategy, lead cross-functionally without authority, and influence product and executive stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on familiarity with data enrichment and identity (waterfall enrichment, matching, intent data), MCP and agentic AI architectures, or composable/API-first platforms.
  • Experience marketing to developers or technical evaluators, including documentation-adjacent and developer-community work.
  • Background in or adjacent to GTM intelligence, ABM, sales intelligence, CDP, iPaaS, or identity platforms.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, Foundation has a differentiated, defensible position that technical buyers recognize; the composable/MCP infrastructure story is landed with the field and the market as something that exists today, not a roadmap promise; the data and identity credibility story is substantiated with proof, not assertion; and the field has the enablement to win the technical evaluation every time it comes.

Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

Unleash Your Potential

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. jobs.description:
Headquarters: Australia
URL: https://zandahealth.com/eu/

Product Owner

Remote | Permanent Contractor | Core EU Collaboration Hours
Reports to: Product Manager

Are you a product driven problem solver who enjoys turning customer insight into things that actually get built? Do you love turning complexity into clarity, aligning teams, and shaping product experiences that genuinely make people’s lives easier? If so, we’d love to meet you!

We build software that takes the stress, chaos, and friction out of managing a health practice. As our newest Product Owner, you’ll play a pivotal role in translating vision into action, turning customer needs into features and driving product outcomes that truly matter.

You’re someone on the rise - intelligent, opinionated (in the best way), and ready to make an impact. You’re not easily swayed, and you’re happy to take a stand when it serves the customer and the product. You connect dots, ask great questions, and care deeply about delivering value. If that sounds like you… read on!

You’re Excited To

  • Be the voice of the customer; advocate for user needs and pain points.

  • Maintain deep customer understanding and share insights with key teams.

  • Translate product priorities into clear, prioritised & actionable items for your team

  • Work closely with engineering to understand constraints, dependencies, and system behaviour

  • Build alignment, trust and collaborate seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Customer Support

  • Ensure continuous delivery of value; own the lifecycle from discovery to post-launch iteration.

  • Guide product decisions that make a real difference for the people using Zanda every day

  • Communicate clearly across async and real-time channels.

  • Surface risks early and drive grounded, data-informed decisions.

  • Contribute to risk-based analysis of product changes and support identification of potential vulnerabilities


What You Bring to the Team

Experience 

  • 2+ years of hands-on product ownership experience (SaaS experience an asset)

  • Proven ability to translate customer pains into clear requirements and impactful improvements

  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and product development architecture

  • Experience in another role before moving into product - a Customer Success, Support, or similar background is a real plus

  • Demonstrated experience working with remote, cross-cultural teams across multiple time zones

Skills 

  • Customer Insight & Discovery - understands user needs, pain points, and motivations.

  • Strategic Thinking -  connects decisions in your product area to customer needs and team priorities

  • Data-Informed Decision Making - uses data to guide choices, even with ambiguity.

  • Clear & Adaptive Communication - complex to simple, and with the audience in mind. 

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration -  works effectively across teams and builds influence through trust, not title.

  • Prioritisation - confidently prioritises what drives the most impact and eliminates noise.

  • Technical Fluency - understands enough to engage meaningfully with engineering.

  • Risk Identification & Mitigation - surfaces risks early and makes grounded decisions.

  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking - breaks down complexity into clear, actionable steps.

Traits 

  • High Ownership Mindset - proactive and treats the product like a business.

  • Collaborative & Empathetic - builds trust quickly and embraces diverse perspectives.

  • Calm Under Pressure - steady when navigating competing priorities or ambiguity.

  • Adaptable & Curious - thrives in fast-changing environments, shows interest in emerging technologies - particularly AI and automation.

  • Integrity-Driven - transparent, reliable, and grounded in facts, not ego.

  • Opinionated (in the right ways) – advocates confidently for what's right for the customer, and isn't easily swayed.

  • Energetic & Self-Starter - brings momentum, enthusiasm, and a bias for action.

  • Strategic Yet Practical - able to zoom out and zoom in fluidly.

  • Growth Oriented - desire to grow, stretch, take on more responsibility, and help influence direction.

  • Customer-Obsessed - curious, empathetic, and motivated to solve real user problems.

                            

 

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

✅ Work from Anywhere
We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together.
✅ Flexibility & Autonomy
We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class.
✅ Generous Paid Time Off
Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work.
✅ High Trust, Results Driven
We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies -  just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference.
✅ Growth & Innovation
You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next.
✅ Inspiring Teammates
You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win.
✅ Meaningful Impact
Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives.
✅ Competitive Pay
We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do.

About Zanda

Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started.

Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable.
To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments.

At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day:

  • Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development.

  • Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers.

  • Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients.

  • Teamwork: We win together -  celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs.

  Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the Zanda Health Privacy Policy.


This is an exciting time to join Zanda. We’re self-funded, scaling quickly, and building something that truly changes lives. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful difference -  we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

Joining Collibra’s CPS Solution Architect Team

At Collibra Public Sector, our Professional Services team relies on Federal Solution Architects to deliver on customer expectations for the services we sell, working directly with customer key projects stakeholders throughout the entire customer journey. Ensuring growth, adoption and renewal, Federal Solution Architects act as customer champions, ensuring customers are onboarded and realizing value rapidly. 

Federal Solution Architects are responsible for

  • Supporting federal customer engagements by delivering mission-aligned architectural design and execution of Collibra products that adhere to Collibra Public Sector’s Delivery Models, Engagement Processes, Methodologies, and Artifacts, while ensuring compliance with applicable government regulations and security standards (e.g., FedRAMP, FISMA, GovCloud).
  • Providing federal agencies with tailored data governance strategies that incorporate best practices, enable knowledge transfer, and drive measurable business and mission outcomes.
  • Partnering cross-functionally with Collibra Sales, Customer Engineering, Product, Support, and Executive teams to ensure alignment with federal acquisition cycles and stakeholder priorities.
  • Identifying opportunities to expand Collibra’s footprint within agencies by aligning product capabilities to evolving agency mandates, modernization efforts, and compliance requirements.
  • Meeting or exceeding utilization goals in support of federal client success, long-term program engagement, and repeatable delivery excellence.
  • Contributing to the growth of Collibra’s public sector services and licensing business through account expansion, strategic planning, and customer advocacy.

You have

Required

  • 5-10 years of consulting experience supporting U.S. federal agencies with knowledge in the areas of Data Governance, Data Management or Data Quality.
  • An understanding of the leading PaaS providers, Data Lakes, Databases, and Integration platforms commonly adopted by federal agencies.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience working with cloud platforms, network-based API integration (REST/JSON), and deployment automation.
  • Linux CLI proficiency.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS/Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure and platform.
  • Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, and Hadoop.
  • Because this role supports the U.S. government business, it is required that this candidate be a U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil and holds active security clearance (Secret/TS/TS-SCI).

Preferred

  • Familiarity in enterprise security solutions such as LDAP or Kerberos.
  • Hands-on experience with Data Quality, Data Pipelines, Data Orchestration, and/or Job Control tools.
  • Knowledgeable of at least least two or three of the following: data management processes, including data governance, data stewardship, master data management, data cataloging, and business rules management
  • Proficiency in leveraging APIs via Java, Python, or similar scripting language for custom software implementations in Enterprise Linux or Unix environments. 
  • Experience with data warehousing, ETL, data integration.
  • Skilled in developing functional and technical specifications.
  • Experienced with Collibra or comparable technologies.

You are

  • Preferably located in the Washington, D.C. metro area to support in-person federal customer engagements, with an on-site requirement of up to 50%.
  • An effective communicator across business and technical stakeholders and able to tailor to different audiences.
  • Always customer-focused and personally hold yourself accountable for the customer’s success.
  • Masterful at troubleshooting, navigating, and facilitating resolution of challenging client connectivity and technical software issues. 
  • Self-starting and interested in learning new software skills to support intricacies of Collibra’s application stack. 
  • Able to work with business and IT owners to identify and align on solutions to data challenges, advocating for the importance of preserving data governance and quality.
  • Able to lead blueprinting, design workshops, and requirements gathering activities.

Measures of success

Within the first 30 days of employment, be able to

  • Present the services offering to your manager understanding the different deliverables and the value provided.
  • Present the Customer Journey framework to your manager understanding the different phases and roles and responsibilities within each phase.

Compensation for this role

The standard base salary range for this position is $96,000 - $120,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits.

jobs.title: Dropbox: Customer Evidence Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada: Select locations

Role Description

Dropbox is hiring a Customer Evidence Manager to own and drive the customer-proof infrastructure that powers our managed sales motion. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a commercially minded, creatively grounded customer marketer who understands that the value of a customer story is not that it gets published — it is that it protects customer trust, gives buyers credible, accurate proof and moves a deal forward. You are the editorial authority on what good looks like, not the person writing every script: execution (writing, video, design) is delivered through agency partners you brief and direct.

Enterprise buyers do not decide on brand claims. They decide on credible proof from organizations like theirs: customer stories, ROI evidence, video testimonials, peer reviews, and competitive validation. In this role, you will produce that evidence and ensure it reaches sellers and customers at the moments it can have the greatest commercial impact.

You will own the program outcomes and operational rigor — setting the creative and editorial bar for what makes a great customer story, directing the agency partners who produce the work, and deploying that proof into active deals — and measuring evidence's impact on pipeline, win rates, and sales-cycle velocity. You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Campaign Enablement, and product teams to prioritize proof for the full suite of Dropbox products and solutions, including  AI capabilities, multi-product platform adoption, and priority vertical workflows. You will get substantial senior Sales and Marketing leadership exposure and a direct, measurable line to revenue during a pivotal shift in how Dropbox goes to market.

Responsibilities

  • Identify advocates, coordinate outreach with account teams, manage consent and approvals, record participation preferences, and avoid customer fatigue. 
  • Set the creative and editorial direction and maintain the evidence taxonomy, freshness, and discoverability of the asset library — case studies, ROI studies, video testimonials, peer/G2 reviews, customer voice, and competitive proof.
  • Manage the sales content library (Highspot, Deeto, or comparable) — organize assets by deal stage, customer profile, vertical, and product; set and enforce freshness standards; and proactively surface content gaps.
  • Run a recurring Sales–Marketing feedback session to understand seller needs, assess content performance in live deals, and prioritize new evidence.
  • Ensure the right proof reaches the right seller for the right deal stage proactively, and track evidence utilization by account executive and deal stage to close adoption gaps.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to build campaign attribution and reporting in Salesforce, measuring evidence's influence on pipeline, win rate, and sales-cycle velocity.
  • Provide monthly reporting to Sales and Marketing on evidence performance and pipeline acceleration, and maintain a rolling pipeline of customers at each stage of evidence development.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in B2B content marketing, customer marketing, or sales enablement — ideally spanning all three.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating a customer evidence, case-study, or advocacy program that sellers actively used in live sales cycles (not solely a published content library).
  • Strong command of complex B2B sales cycles and the specific evidence needed at each stage, from discovery and evaluation through procurement and legal review.
  • Direct experience partnering with account executives and SDRs to produce commercially effective content and enablement.
  • A creative/editorial background with strong instincts for what makes a compelling customer story and credible social proof — able to set the bar, write briefs, direct and manage agency partners, and edit to a high standard (rather than personally produce every asset), while managing multiple stories and stakeholders at once.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with Highspot, Seismic, DocSend, or a comparable sales content platform.
  • Experience with Salesforce campaign attribution, pipeline reporting, or closely related revenue analytics — able to connect content performance to business outcomes.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or managed sales motions in a SaaS environment.
  • Experience developing customer proof for AI products, workflow products, or multi-product platform adoption.
  • Familiarity with G2 or other peer-review programs, and with GEO / customer-voice strategy.
  • Experience partnering with Marketing Operations/Campaign Enablement/ Marketing Data Science on content attribution and sales-content analytics.
  • Experience developing evidence for priority verticals (e.g. marketing and creative and Architecture, Engineering and Construction.)

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

Canada Pay Range
$142,800—$193,200 CAD

jobs.title: Huntress: Security Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote US

Reports to: Manager, Security Operations Center

Location: Remote, US

Compensation Range: $100,000-$125,000 base plus bonus and equity. This role may be eligible for on-call/call-in pay in addition to base pay 

*The initial training period for this position will be Monday-Friday. Following training, the work schedule is subject to change and may include weekend or a 4x10 shift, depending on business requirements*

What We Do:

Huntress is a fully remote, global team of passionate experts and ethical badasses on a mission to break down the barriers to cybersecurity. Whether creating purpose-built security solutions, hunting down hackers, or impacting our community, our people go above and beyond to change the security game and make a real difference.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress protects all businesses—not just the 1%—with enterprise-grade, fully owned, and managed cybersecurity products at the price of an affordable SaaS application. The Huntress difference is our One Team advantage: our technology is designed with our industry-defining Security Operations Center (SOC) in mind and is never separated from our service.

We protect 4M+ endpoints and 7M+ identities worldwide, elevating underresourced IT teams with protection that works as hard as they do. As long as hackers keep hacking, Huntress keeps hunting.

What You’ll Do:

Huntress is looking for a Security Operations Center Analyst to add to our growing team. In this role, you will get to triage, investigate, respond, and remediate a variety of intrusions on a daily basis. You’ll be surrounded by passionate individuals who are mission-driven to help protect companies around the world from cyberattacks and will have daily opportunities to progress your analyst skillset and accelerate your career growth.

The Huntress Security Operations Center is an elite team of individuals who wake up every day to combat threat actors. You will have daily opportunities to progress your analysis skills while being at the forefront of what’s happening in the wild. If you’re looking to accelerate your career and skills, this is the team for you!

Responsibilities:

  • Triage, investigate, and respond to alerts coming in from the Huntress platform.
  • Perform tactical review of EDR telemetry, log sources, and forensic artifacts to determine the root cause of attacks, where possible, and provide remediations needed to remove the threat.
  • Perform tactical malware analysis as part of investigating and triaging alerts.
  • Investigate suspicious Microsoft M365 activity and provide remediations.
  • Assist in escalations from the Product Support team for threat-related and SOC-relevant questions.
  • Contribute to detection engineering creation and tuning efforts.
  • Contribute to projects focused on driving better outcomes for our analysts and partners
  • Contribute to our collaboratively mentored team (we're all here to make each other better!).

What You Bring To The Team:  

  • 4+ years of experience in a SOC or Digital Forensics (DFIR) role
  • Demonstrated experience with Windows, Linux, and MacOS as an attack surface
  • Demonstrated experience with basic Threat Actor tools and techniques: (MITRE ATT&CK Framework, PowerShell & Command Prompt Terminals, WMIC, Scheduled Tasks, SCM, Windows Domain and host Enumeration Techniques, Basic Lateral Movement Techniques, Basic Persistence Mechanisms, Basic Defense Evasion Techniques, other offensive/Red Team TTPs)
  • Demonstrated experience with static and dynamic malware analysis concepts
  • Working knowledge of Windows Administration or Enterprise Domain Administration
    • Active Directory, Group Policy, Domain Trusts, etc.
  • Working knowledge of core networking concepts
    • Common ports/protocols, NAT, Public/Private IPs, VLANs, etc.
  • Working knowledge of web technologies and concepts 
    • Web servers/applications, OWASP top 10, etc.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to explain complex events to less technical audiences, enabling effective cross-functional collaboration within the SOC and across departments
  • Dedicated to prioritizing and addressing customer needs and concerns in all decision-making processes
  • A strong sense of curiosity and a genuine excitement for learning

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in an MSP/MSSP/MDR role
  • Linux and MacOS investigative experience 
  • Experience with scripting languages (such as PowerShell, Python, Bash, PHP, JavaScript, or Ruby)
  • Demonstrated experience on platforms such as HackTheBox, TryHackMe, Blue Team Labs Online, etc. 
  • Demonstrated experience with Cloud-based investigations such as M365, Azure, AWS, GCP, etc.
  • Participation in cybersecurity competitions such as Capture the Flags, the Collegiate Cyber Defense Competition, etc.
  • Familiarity with MSP tools such as RMMs

What We Offer: 

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans 
  • 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution
  • Life and Disability insurance plans
  • Stock options for all full-time employees 
  • One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office
  • Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance 
  • $75 USD/month digital reimbursement
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

  

Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are. 

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

Paragon Planners is looking for a professional, dependable, and highly organized Administrative Scheduler to join our remote team.

In this role, you’ll support professionals in the financial services industry by managing schedules, connecting with clients, and helping keep their day-to-day operations organized and running smoothly.

This position offers 20–30 hours per week, with work taking place during regular Monday - Friday business hours. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, takes pride in staying organized, and is looking for meaningful professional work without a traditional 40-hour schedule.

What You’ll Do

As an Administrative Scheduler, you’ll build relationships with the professionals you support while helping them stay connected with their clients.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Making outbound calls to schedule and confirm appointments

  • Communicating professionally with clients by phone and email

  • Managing calendars and coordinating schedules

  • Entering and maintaining accurate information in client databases

  • Following established processes and client-specific instructions

  • Providing dependable administrative support throughout the workweek

This role is a good fit for someone who is personable, comfortable on the phone, detail-oriented, and enjoys being the person who keeps things organized behind the scenes.

Schedule & Availability

Because our Administrative Schedulers support clients throughout the business day, consistent Monday–Friday availability is required.

  • Availability is needed during standard business hours, generally 8:30 AM–5:00 PM in the client’s time zone

  • Both morning and afternoon availability are required throughout the week

  • Working hours may not fall into one continuous block each day

  • Schedules are based on the needs of the clients you support

  • Initial hours may build gradually as you complete onboarding and are assigned to clients

This position is designed for candidates specifically seeking part-time work. If you are seeking a traditional 40-hour workweek or full-time employment, this position will not be the right fit.

Training & Onboarding

We provide training and support to help new employees learn our systems, processes, and the expectations of the role.

New employees should plan for approximately 8–12 hours of training per week during the initial training period. As you progress through onboarding, you may begin working with clients while continuing to complete your training.

Client assignments are based on current business needs and finding the right match between employees and the professionals they support, so candidates should be comfortable with a gradual ramp-up in hours.

What We’re Looking For

Successful candidates are typically:

  • Warm, polished, and professional communicators

  • Comfortable speaking with clients by phone

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented

  • Dependable and responsive

  • Able to work independently and manage their time effectively

  • Comfortable following detailed instructions and adapting to different client preferences

  • Comfortable learning new technology

  • Experienced in administrative support, scheduling, customer service, or another client-facing role

  • Interested in a long-term professional opportunity

Previous remote-work experience is helpful, but not required.

Location Requirements

We are currently only hiring in the following states: AL, AZ, FL, GA, ID, KY, LA, MI, MO, NC, OH, OR, SC, TN, TX, UT & WY.

Applicants must reside in one of the states listed above to be considered.

We do not hire outside of the United States.

Home Office & Technology Requirements

Because this is a fully remote position, employees must have:

  • A quiet, professional home-office environment suitable for client calls

  • Reliable high-speed internet

  • A Windows 11 computer

  • The ability to participate in video meetings and training

Macs, iPads, Chromebooks, and virtual machines are not compatible with the technology requirements of this position.

Background Screening

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of required background screening. Due to the nature of our work within the financial services industry, our screening process is comprehensive and may include multiple background checks.

Compensation

Starting pay: $18.50–$20.00 per hour, based on relevant experience.

Employees are eligible for a compensation review after six months, with opportunities for continued increases as they gain experience and tenure with Paragon Planners.

Paragon Planners provides administrative and scheduling support to professionals in the financial services industry. Our remote team helps clients manage their schedules, stay connected with their customers, and keep important day-to-day details moving.

We value professionalism, dependability, strong communication, and people who genuinely enjoy helping others.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. 

As our Partner Marketing Manager you will be responsible for turning strategic partnerships into a measurable pipeline motion- building the co-marketing programs, and partner activation strategies that help communicate the power of 6Sense alongside our key partners. This is a builder's role for someone who wants to own a meaningful piece of how 6sense grows, and who understands that great partner marketing sits at the intersection of relationship depth and disciplined execution. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Joint Go-to-Market Programs
    Build and run co-marketing programs with strategic partners, from end to end: partner alignment, asset development, campaign execution, field activation, and measurement. Own the pipeline contribution from partner marketing activity and be accountable for reporting it clearly. 
  • Joint Events and Activations
    Own the partner presence at key industry events (including our own, BreakThrough), co-hosted webinars, and joint field programs. Coordinate logistics, messaging, and follow-up across both sides of the partnership to make sure activations generate pipeline. 
  • Partner Relationships
    Serve as the primary marketing counterpart to partner marketing and alliances teams at key accounts. Build the kind of working relationships where partner counterparts are actively seeking us out. Create opportunities for 6sense to co-present at joint events, and develop the trust that makes joint programs move faster. 
  • Partner Marketing Metrics
    Define what success looks like for partner marketing at 6sense, working with marketing operations to build the reporting infrastructure to measure it, and communicate results to marketing leadership and BD stakeholders on a regular cadence. 
  • Performance Measurement 
  • Partner-Sourced Pipeline
    Volume and velocity of pipeline generated through co-marketing programs and partner activations, tracked with clear attribution. 
  • Partner Marketing Engagement
    Depth of engagement from partner counterparts: co-investment in programs, co-branded content produced, joint events executed, and partner-sourced leads generated. 
  • Enablement Adoption
    Usage and effectiveness of partner-facing enablement materials, measured by partner sales team feedback and co-sell conversation rates. 
  • Program Execution Quality
    On-time, on-brief delivery of co-marketing programs - with the partner relationship strengthened as a result. 

Competencies and Behaviors: 

  • Influence Without Authority Operates effectively in an environment where the people you most depend on (partner counterparts, internal sales, product marketing) don't report into the same leadership. Builds alignment through credibility and relationships. 
  • Revenue-First Thinking Connects every program to pipeline and revenue. Doesn't measure success by content produced or events run. Asks "what did this produce?" and builds programs that are designed to answer that question. 
  • Partner-Facing Presence Comfortable representing 6sense externally. Shows up in partner conversations with enough confidence and preparation to be a genuine asset in the room. 
  • Execution Discipline Manages the complexity of co-marketing at pace. Gets joint programs across the finish line even when approval chains are complex. 
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration Works fluidly across product marketing, demand generation, content, field marketing, and BD to bring partner programs to life.

Educational and Experience Requirements:

  • 5 or more years in B2B marketing, with at least 2 years in a field marketing role, partner marketing, alliance marketing, or ecosystem marketing role where you owned outcomes and field programs. 
  • Experience working directly with external partner stakeholders. You have presented to partner leadership, negotiated co-marketing agreements, and maintained productive relationships through disagreements. 
  • A clear point of view on how to measure partner marketing impact, including how to handle the attribution ambiguity that comes with the territory. 
  • Familiarity with the B2B SaaS technology ecosystem: how ISV partnerships, technology integrations, and co-sell motions work in practice.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States (Remote)

Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. 

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

 

The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement. 

This position requires residency in the Greater Nashville Area.


What You’ll Do:

Dealer Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners
  • Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers
  • Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule
  • Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty

 

Dealer Acquisition & Activation

  • Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners
  • Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”)
  • Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production
  • Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems

 

Production & Volume Growth

  • Achieve monthly funding and application volume goals
  • Increase contracts per active dealer and overall territory production
  • Focus on growing volume in Tier 3–5 segments while maintaining quality
  • Drive penetration targets (e.g., 3+ and 5+ deals per dealer per month)

 

Credit & Deal Structuring

  • Partner closely with underwriting/credit teams to structure deals effectively
  • Educate dealers on program guidelines, stips, and deal packaging
  • Improve pull-through by coaching dealers on submitting clean, fundable deals

 

Portfolio Performance & Quality

  • Monitor dealer portfolio performance (delinquency, charge-offs, profitability)
  • Manage dealer mix to align with company risk appetite and profitability goals
  • Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers
  • Ensure adherence to compliance, credit policies, and documentation standards

 

Training & Dealer Development

  • Conduct ongoing product and process training with dealership staff
  • Educate dealers on value-added products 
  • Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success
  • Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender

 

Territory & Activity Management

  • Maintain a disciplined weekly drive schedule maximizing in-person dealer time
  • Track and manage activity through CRM (e.g., Salesforce)
  • Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data
  • Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews


What We Look For:

  • 2+ years of experience in indirect auto finance, auto sales, or related field
  • Strong understanding of credit tiers, loan structuring, and dealership operations
  • Proven ability to build relationships and drive sales growth
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • Self-motivated with strong time management and territory planning skills
  • Ability to travel locally (significant field time required)

 

What We Offer You: 

  • Competitive salary, uncapped commission and stock option plan
  • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • Competitive 401(k) and RRSP program
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Paid parental leave
  • Health & wellness initiatives

Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

 

 

About the Role:

The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement.  This position requires residency in Dallas/Fort Worth, TX.


What You’ll Do:

Dealer Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners
  • Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers
  • Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule
  • Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty

 

Dealer Acquisition & Activation

  • Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners
  • Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”)
  • Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production
  • Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems

 

Production & Volume Growth

  • Increase contracts per active dealer and overall territory production
  • Focus on growing volume in Tier 3–5 segments while maintaining quality

Credit & Deal Structuring

Portfolio Performance & Quality

  • Manage dealer mix to align with company risk appetite and profitability goals
  • Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers
  • Ensure adherence to compliance, credit policies, and documentation standards

 

Training & Dealer Development

  • Conduct ongoing product and process training with dealership staff
  • Educate dealers on value-added products 
  • Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success
  • Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender

 

Territory & Activity Management

  • Maintain a disciplined weekly drive schedule maximizing in-person dealer time
  • Track and manage activity through CRM (e.g., Salesforce)
  • Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data
  • Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews


What We Look For:

  • 2+ years of experience in indirect auto finance, auto sales, or related field
  • Strong understanding of credit tiers, loan structuring, and dealership operations
  • Proven ability to build relationships and drive sales growth
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • Self-motivated with strong time management and territory planning skills
  • Ability to travel locally (significant field time required)

  • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

jobs.title: Clover Health: Chief Actuary
jobs.description:
Headquarters: NY, United States
URL: https://www.cloverhealth.com/

Chief Actuary

Remote - USA

The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Actuarial is at the center of some of Clover's most important decisions—from pricing and forecasting to reserving, medical economics, and long-term strategy. As Chief Actuary, you'll lead and evolve this function during a pivotal stage of the company's growth, helping shape how we deploy AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve decision-making across the business.

This isn't a traditional Chief Actuary role. We're looking for someone who can combine deep actuarial expertise with modern technology, building AI-enabled workflows that transform how actuarial work gets done while maintaining the rigor, transparency, and governance required in a highly regulated environment. You'll partner closely with leaders across Finance, Clinical, Growth, Operations, and Product to influence company strategy while building a best-in-class actuarial organization.

As a Chief Actuary, you will:

  • Lead Clover's enterprise actuarial function, including pricing, forecasting, reserving, medical economics, Part D, Stars analytics, and bid strategy.
  • Establish the long-term vision for actuarial, modernizing the function through AI, automation, and scalable analytical infrastructure. 
  •  Build AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual effort, accelerate insight generation, and improve actuarial decision-making while ensuring explainability, governance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead the annual Medicare Advantage bid strategy and pricing process, framing tradeoffs among growth, competitiveness, margin, risk, and capital requirements to support enterprise planning and executive decision-making.
  • Assume responsibility for actuarial opinions, reserve adequacy, and related regulatory actuarial requirements, including transitioning responsibilities currently supported by external actuarial partners.
  • Guide reserving methodology, IBNR development, forecasting, and emerging experience analysis to provide timely, reliable financial insights.
  • Partner with Finance leadership to strengthen forecasting, planning, capital management, and enterprise performance measurement.
  • Collaborate with Medical Economics to identify healthcare cost trends, evaluate interventions, and develop strategies that improve member outcomes while managing medical expense. 
  •  Drive adoption of modern analytics tools and AI capabilities across the actuarial organization, helping the team operate faster, smarter, and with greater transparency.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, translating complex actuarial concepts into clear business recommendations. 
  • Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing actuarial organization, including organizational design, performance management, workforce capacity, and development of actuarial and analytical talent.
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Clinical, Operations, Growth, Data Science, and Engineering to ensure actuarial insights are embedded in strategic decision-making.
  • Establish and maintain actuarial governance, model review, documentation, control, and validation standards that support regulatory compliance, financial integrity, and sound executive decision-making.

Success in this role looks like:

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the clientâs broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

About KPI Solutions

KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. Position SummaryÂ 

The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â
